Page 2 of 4

lam writing to formally request a review of

the professional conduct and clinical
practices of Kenneth Emeka Ezenwa, NP
(License #950801 78) regarding a telehealth

encounter on May 26, 2026. This submission
focuses on Mr. Ezenwas clinical performance
and adherence to the Nursing Practice Act.
Please note that a related administrative
privacy complaint is currently under review

by the OCR (Ticket #72).
Professional Conduct and Clinical Oversight
Issues:
Failure to Review Clinical History: At the

start of our appointment, Mr. Ezenwa stated
he had no access to my medication history
or records. He remained unprepared to

proceed until | offered to read him the dates
from my personal CURES report, which

necessitated him placing me on hold to
contact his office. This indicates a significant
failure to review patient records prior to
providing clinical services.
Improper Prescribing and Overriding Patient

Boundaries: During the encounter, | explicitly
communicated that | was in the process of a
“warm hand-off" for my Diazepam taper from
my current provider and clearly declined the

addition of Sertraline. Mr. Ezenwa repeatedly
refused to accept this boundary, persisting
in his demand for the medication until |

ultimately consented solely to end the
circular and unproductive exchange. This
behavior reflects a disregard for patient
boundaries and a failure to engage in the
collaborative, informed decision-making
required by the Nursing Practice Act. My
pharmacy records confirm this prescribing
activity, which occurred despite my clear,
documented objections during the
appointment.
Substandard Administrative Environment:
The appointment was characterized by a

chaotic communication breakdown,
involving multiple overlapping calls from
clinic lines during the scheduled telehealth
window. This prevented a professional
clinical environment and impeded my ability
to access care.

Request for Action:
| request that the Board investigate Mr.
Ezenwas adherence to the Nursing Practice
